policy: Outcome-selected six-case diagnostic: two additional native controls (one consensus improvement, one contour/overall-distance disagreement), two external sources, one altered input, and one regression on a previously very-close gesture. Not a representative quality estimate. New candidates are raw predictions, without local search.

rows.label: New reference · gentle rise
rows.reason: Additional native controls; both aggregate matching and tracked pitch improve. Test a numerical consensus case.

rows.label: New reference · wide rising sweep
rows.reason: Additional native controls; aggregate score and median pitch improve, while full-contour error worsens. Diagnose what listeners hear.

rows.label: Footsteppr source sound
rows.reason: External source; the further-trained single expert improves strongly while the mixture does not. Test transfer beyond native Transfxr.

rows.label: Boomr source sound
rows.reason: Compare the new mixture against the exact prior combined-model winner; prior absolute likeness remains unknown, not invented.

rows.label: Bouncing rise · low-pass filtered
rows.reason: Altered input; aggregate distance and tracked contour improve. This filtered reference has not been judged before.

rows.label: Warbling sweep
rows.reason: Known very-close native gesture. The mixture has worse matching distance; test whether the numerical regression is audible.
